author: itaity
body:
A new walls map by me (horay!)

Some cool features:
  • Futuristic spaceship design
  • Astronaut villagers that wandering around the map and offer goods for emerald (which can be obtained from the cold corpses of rival players) 
  • Roof (:O)


Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/3w4s4m3apbu2g6k/The%20Walls%20-%20Vacuum%20%28Version%201.0%29.rar?dl=0
Album: https://imgur.com/a/pCErA
